global: banjo, ukulele, tuba, pizzicato strings, light brushed drums, toy horn

sections.name: hook
sections.style: zippy country chase: fast banjo and slap bass, a big truck zooming by, cheeky, ends on a comic brass sting

sections.name: tiny
sections.style: small and cute: plucky ukulele and toy glockenspiel tiptoe, a tuba answers low and big

sections.name: wheel
sections.style: curious question: pizzicato and a sly clarinet, a surprised little honk at the end

sections.name: slow
sections.style: slow lazy shuffle: tuba and brushed drums at walking pace, a sad trombone slide, deadpan

sections.name: hauls
sections.style: proud bouncy country stomp, banjo and handclaps, building up, then a cool breezy shimmer

sections.name: revival
sections.style: dusty music box creak, then a grand drumroll into a bright brass fanfare reveal

sections.name: ending
sections.style: warm sunset country outro, gentle banjo and whistle melody, playful button at the end
